identity.title: Prevent ImageCanvas timer callback failure during disposal

origin.kind: current-source audit and reproducible lifecycle probe
origin.summary: The current ImageCanvas timer callback was invoked after the view-model timer field had been cleared, reproducing a NullReferenceException before any WPF or hardware runtime was required.

state.current_summary: The timer callback now snapshots the timer, returns when the timer is unavailable, and keeps the existing disposal exception boundary. The confirmed null-timer failure is fixed; focused probe, ImageCanvas build, solution Debug/Release builds, readiness, and the representative workspace image-load smoke all passed.

claims.text: Invoking RoiImageCanvasViewModel._dataTimer_Elapsed after construction state has no timer produces a NullReferenceException at _refreshTimer.Stop().

problem.impact: A queued System.Timers.Timer callback can race with Dispose after _refreshTimer is cleared and surface an unhandled callback exception during ImageCanvas shutdown or view replacement.

criteria.text: The timer callback returns without an exception when the timer field is null and does not call Stop on a cleared timer.
The affected ImageCanvas project and the solution build successfully with no new warnings or errors, and existing readiness verification remains green.

evidence.observation: A reflection probe loaded the Debug ImageCanvas assembly, created an uninitialized RoiImageCanvasViewModel with a null _refreshTimer, invoked the private _dataTimer_Elapsed callback, and caught a MethodInvocationException whose inner exception was System.NullReferenceException with message 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'.
The same reflection probe invoked _dataTimer_Elapsed with a null _refreshTimer after the guard was added and completed with NULL_TIMER_CALLBACK=OK and exit code 0.
OpenVisionLab.ImageCanvas Debug build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
The full OpenVisionLab solution Debug and Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
OpenVisionReadinessCheck completed with all 13 checks OK in both Debug and Release and reported OpenVisionLab readiness contract passed.
The representative wpf_shell_host_workspace_image_load smoke completed with check=OK, elapsed=10686ms, and exit code 0 after the ImageCanvas lifetime change.

events.summary: The reproduced null-timer callback defect was fixed with the smallest local lifecycle guard and all required focused checks passed.
